snippet.title: Midway Arcade Treasures 3 (2005), E3 2005 Videogame trailer |PS2, Xbox & GameCube
snippet.description:
Midway Arcade Treasures 3 (2005), Videogame trailer (PS2, Xbox, GameCube)

Midway Arcade Treasures 3 is a classic arcade-themed compilation game in the Midway Arcade Treasures series by Backbone Entertainment and Midway Games and released 2005 to PlayStation 2, Xbox, and GameCube platforms.
